statement: The proportion of SUID cases with multivitamin use during pregnancy is lower compared to PRAMS mothers in 2012-2015.
rationale: This design compares the frequency of multivitamin use between SUID cases and a population reference, using available data from NCFRP_v51 and PRAMS_p7_arf. The comparison will be limited to proportions due to lack of a denominator source for incidence rates or risk ratios.
prior_art: None in the inputs; existing studies focus on other risk factors like smoking during pregnancy but do not address multivitamin use among SUID cases compared with a general population reference.
cannot_establish: This design can only establish an association between multivitamin use and SUID cases compared with a population reference. It cannot establish causation or estimate incidence rates due to the lack of a denominator source.
